stories.title: Provider notifies Consumer about incorrectly signed usage contract offer

user_story.i want: to notify the Consumer when the signed usage contract offer received from the Consumer is incorrectly signed or cannot be validated,
user_story.so that: the Consumer is informed that the contract establishment process cannot continue with the submitted signed offer.

acs.label: AC1
acs.heading: AC1 Notification request is created and sent after failed signed contract validation

clauses.text: Provider-side Contract Management validates a signed usage contract offer received from the Consumer
the validation detects that the signed usage contract offer is incorrectly signed, invalid or cannot be validated successfully
Contract Management creates a notification request for the Consumer
the notification request contains business context indicating that the signed usage contract offer could not be validated successfully
the notification request contains the recipient context derived from the contract negotiation / participant context
the notification request contains correlationId where available
the notification request is sent to the SIMPL Notification Service according to the agreed Notification Service integration contract.

acs.label: AC2
acs.heading: AC2 Consumer recipient is resolved from contract context

clauses.text: a notification request needs to be sent to the Consumer
Contract Management prepares the notification request
the Consumer recipient context is resolved from the contract negotiation / participant context
the notification request is prepared for the resolved Consumer recipient according to the agreed Notification Service integration contract.

acs.label: AC3
acs.heading: AC3 Recipient cannot be resolved

clauses.text: Contract Management cannot resolve the Consumer recipient
the notification request cannot be completed
the failure is logged with correlationId and error information where available
no invalid notification request is sent to the Notification Service.

acs.label: AC4
acs.heading: AC4 Notification Service accepts the notification request

clauses.text: Contract Management sends the notification request to the SIMPL Notification Service
the Notification Service accepts the request
Contract Management records the successful handoff with correlationId where available
the notification request is treated as successfully handed over to the Notification Service.

acs.label: AC5
acs.heading: AC5 Notification Service rejects or fails the notification request

clauses.text: Contract Management sends the notification request to the SIMPL Notification Service
the Notification Service returns an error or the notification request cannot be handed over
the failure is logged with correlationId and error information where available
the failure is handled according to the error handling / retry behaviour defined by the agreed Notification Service integration contract.

acs.label: AC6
acs.heading: AC6 Notification delivery is handled by Notification Service

clauses.text: the notification request has been successfully handed over to the SIMPL Notification Service
the notification is processed further
actual email / message delivery is handled by the Notification Service
Contract Management does not implement its own email sender or custom notification delivery mechanism.

other_text: The trigger for this notification is the validation failure outcome produced by Provider-side Contract Management during validation of the Consumer-signed usage contract offer.
The validation logic itself is covered by SIMPL-19933 and SIMPL-19943. SIMPL-21966 should not retest the full validation logic.
This story covers only the Contract Management-side preparation and handoff of the notification request to the SIMPL Notification Service.

The final Notification Service integration mechanism, request/response contract, supported payload fields, error responses and retry behaviour must follow the agreed Notification Service contract defined under SIMPL-29268.
Contract Management must not implement a direct SMTP integration, custom email sender or its own notification delivery mechanism.
Recipient contact details must not be hardcoded in Contract Management. This is a technical implementation constraint and may be verified through implementation/configuration review where required.
This story reuses the existing SIMPL Notification Service.
The integration with Notification Service is asynchronous and Kafka based. It is not a dedicated REST endpoint exposed by Contract Management.
Contract Management should publish an EmailNotification message to the existing notifications Kafka topic.
The Notification Service consumes the message and sends the email notification to the Consumer.
The EmailNotification payload must remain compliant with the existing Notification Service AsyncAPI schema.
The EmailNotification payload should contain only fields supported by the Notification Service AsyncAPI schema, such as:
The business context for this notification should be reflected in the subject and/or message body where appropriate.

Additional technical context such as contractNegotiationId, participant IDs and correlationId should be available in Contract Management logs and/or message metadata where supported by the integration.
If PSO requires these fields as dedicated attributes in the Kafka message payload, this should be handled as a separate change to the Notification Service AsyncAPI contract.

acs.label: AC3
acs.heading: AC3: Scheduler does not terminate finalized contracts (Negative scenario)

clauses.text: the Contract UI backend has a configured timeout value
a contract offer older than the timeout is already finalized and scheduler is executed
the contract is not changed

clauses.text: a contract offer was terminated by the scheduler
the Consumer user opens the contract offers list in the Contract UI frontend (or uses contract UI backend API)

other_text: A new scheduler will be introduced in the Contract UI backend. It will:
* Execute every day at 01:00 (configurable in application.properties and values.yaml)

* Search for all contract offers in the Pending state that are older than the timeout, counted from the creation date in the Contract UI database (default 7 days, configurable in application.properties and values.yaml)
** Mark it as terminated in contract UI database
** Send a rejection request to the Contract Manager /contractOffers/{contractNegotiationId}/reject, which will propagate to the EDC connector (and will finally cause contract termination)

processes.title: BP07 – Consumer and Provider establish a usage contract for selected catalogue items
7.1 - A Consumer requests a new usage contract offer
7.2 - A Provider verifies the request for a usage contract offer
7.3 - A Provider creates and provides the usage contract offer
7.4 - A Consumer reviews the usage contract offer
7.5 - A Consumer signs, stores and provide the usage contract offer
7.6 - A Provider validates the signed usage contract offer

bp_requirements.title: Request usage contract offer
bp_requirements.text: The _Consumer_ requests a usage contract based on their selection of a desired resource from the data space catalogue (BP06).

bp_requirements.title: Verify access policy
bp_requirements.text: The _Provider_ verifies the _Consumer_ description details (as described in their self-description) to ensure that they are allowed to access the requested resource according to the access policies.

bp_requirements.title: Verify existence usage contract
bp_requirements.text: The _Provider_ verifies whether the _Consumer_ already has an established usage contract in place for the desired resource from the data space catalogue.

bp_requirements.title: Provide usage contract
bp_requirements.text: The _Provider_ creates a formal usage contract in response to the usage contract request from the _Consumer_.

bp_requirements.title: Review terms and conditions of usage contract
bp_requirements.text: The _Consumer_ reviews the usage contract and decides whether to agree to the terms and conditions.

bp_requirements.title: Sign usage contract
bp_requirements.text: If the _Consumer_ agrees to the terms and conditions, they sign the usage contract.

bp_requirements.title: Store usage contract
bp_requirements.text: The _Consumer_ securely stores the finalised usage contract as part of their official business records for future reference, compliance, and operational needs.

bp_requirements.title: Validate usage contract
bp_requirements.text: The _Provider_ validates that the _Consumer_ has formally agreed to the usage contract, ensuring they have accepted the terms and conditions established by the _Provider_.

bp_requirements.title: Sign usage contract
bp_requirements.text: If the validation is successful, the _Provider_ signs the usage contract.

bp_requirements.title: Store usage contract
bp_requirements.text: The _Provider_ securely stores the finalised usage contract as part of their official business records for future reference, compliance, and operational needs.

bp_requirements.title: Notify Consumer
bp_requirements.text: The _Provider_ notifies the _Consumer_ that they have signed and stored the usage contract. The signed usage contract is made available to the _Consumer_.

bp_requirements.title: Confirm usage contract
bp_requirements.text: The _Consumer_ confirms the signed usage contract from the _Provider_ against the original usage contract request (from BP07.01), to ensure consistency and accuracy.

bp_requirements.title: A Consumer initiates the request for a usage contract offer
bp_requirements.text: Simpl-Open shall support the Consumer via UI and API to initiate a usage contract offer request.

bp_requirements.title: A Provider verifies the access policies
bp_requirements.text: Simpl-Open shall support the Provider to automatically verify access policies.

bp_requirements.title: A Provider verifies existence of a usage contract
bp_requirements.text: Simpl-Open shall support the Provider to automatically verify existing usage contracts.

bp_requirements.title: A Provider creates the usage contract offer
bp_requirements.text: Simpl-Open shall support the Provider to automatically create the usage contract offer.

bp_requirements.title: A Provider provides the usage contract offer to a Consumer
bp_requirements.text: Simpl-Open shall support the Provider to automatically provide the usage contract offer to a Consumer.

bp_requirements.title: A Consumer reviews the usage contract offer
bp_requirements.text: Simpl-Open shall support the Consumer via UI and API to review the usage contract offer.

bp_requirements.title: A Consumer notifies the Provider about the rejection of the usage contract offer
bp_requirements.text: Simpl-Open shall support the Consumer to automatically notify the Provider about a rejection.

bp_requirements.title: A Consumer signs the usage contract offer
bp_requirements.text: Simpl-Open shall support the Consumer via UI and API to sign the usage contract offer.

bp_requirements.title: A Consumer stores the signed usage contract offer and provide it to the Provider
bp_requirements.text: Simpl-Open shall support the Consumer to automatically store and forward the signed offer.

bp_requirements.title: A Provider validates the signed usage contract offer
bp_requirements.text: Simpl-Open shall support the Provider via UI and API to validate the signed usage contract offer.

bp_requirements.title: A Provider signs the usage contract offer
bp_requirements.text: Simpl-Open shall support the Provider via UI and API to sign the usage contract offer.

bp_requirements.title: A Provider stores the signed usage contract
bp_requirements.text: Simpl-Open shall support the Provider to automatically store the signed usage contract.

bp_requirements.title: A Provider provides the signed usage contract to a Consumer
bp_requirements.text: Simpl-Open shall support the Provider to automatically provide the signed contract to the Consumer.

bp_requirements.title: A Consumer validates the signed usage contract
bp_requirements.text: Simpl-Open shall support the Consumer via UI and API to validate the signed usage contract.

bp_requirements.title: Prepare and store billing data
bp_requirements.text: The _Provider_ prepares the billing data from the billing schema, the _Consumer_ and _Provider_ information and the reference to the usage contract, and stores it for auditability.

bp_requirements.title: Make billing data available to the Provider's billing system
bp_requirements.text: The _Provider_ makes the billing data available to their own billing system for the generation of the invoice. Invoice generation is outside the scope of Simpl-Open.

bp_requirements.title: Send billing data to the Consumer
bp_requirements.text: The _Provider_ sends the prepared billing data to the _Consumer_.

bp_requirements.title: Store the Consumer's billing data
bp_requirements.text: The _Consumer_ stores the received billing data for auditability and traceability.

bp_requirements.title: Contract enforcement (BP11)
bp_requirements.text: The _Provider_ checks the credit status and takes the follow-up actions agreed in the contract, for example suspension, notifying both parties.
